_comment: Hand-written (the Forge has no sprites tool yet — llm-rpg-85g.9). Maps tile NAMES from the game legend to sprite ids in apps/web/public/assets/manifest.json. Characters carry their sprite inline on the entity (entity.sprite wins over this file), so only the player and a couple of unmapped extras live here. Everything unmapped falls back to the game's emoji glyph — deliberate for the altar, the ash heap, the courtyard dust, the whirlwind waystones (🌪) and the animals: the CC0 tileset has no art for them and an honest emoji beats a wrong sprite.
